description: Information trafic en temps réel affectant les réseaux de transports en commun de la Métropole d'Aix-Marseille-Provence is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Baptiste RUELLO-BABALONI. This real-time feed in standard GTFS-RT Service Alerts format (version 2.0) centralizes passenger information and traffic alerts impacting all the public transport networks of the Aix-Marseille-Provence Metropolis, combined under the unique brand La Métropole Mobility. Coverage: Baptiste RUELLO-BABALONI. The portal shows the English title as "Real-time traffic information affecting the public transport networks of the Metropolis of Aix-Marseille-Provence" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Baptiste RUELLO-BABALONI. Its keywords include ligne-de-bus, marseille, transport-en-commun, info-trafic, transport-collectif, perturbations-service. The listing shows 1 download or service links in GTFS-RT. The listing shows 2026-06-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
